news.title:
PSU Bank shares, including Bank of Maharashtra, SBI, Canara Bank, BoB, and PNB, surged 11-30% this month post RBI's ECL guidelines.
New ECL framework impacts PSU Banks more, with provisioning rising sharply and net worth hit of 5-10%, while private banks remain insulated.
